verdict.rationale: Release health is a fair question for an error-tracking platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows deployment tracking: a deploy history, code-diff links between deploys, auto-resolve on deploy, and an 'occurred.after:last deploy' search filter. These are adjacent features. Nothing in the pack documents crash-free session or user metrics, per-release adoption, or comparing a canary release against the last stable one.
